Mnookin Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Allison Mnookin is a Senior Lecturer of Business Administration in the Technology and Operations Management (TOM) Unit at the Harvard Business School. She currently is the co-chair of the first-year MBA Technology and Operations Management course. In addition, she has taught the elective course Building and Sustaining a Successful Enterprise (BSSE).
